Name: SK's Vanilla Tweaks-Style Fish Expansions
Author: seifkingSK
Description:
[img]https://i.imgur.com/UINQfef.png[/img]﻿
[center][size=3]This is a retexture for fish assets from big mods to match [/size][b][color=#e69138][url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/21433]Vanilla Tweaks[/url]﻿[/color][/b][size=3] art style![/size]

[size=3]This mod uses [/size][b]CMCT [/b][size=3]to grab configuration settings from the original [/size][b]VT [/b][size=3]mod for [/size][i][u]saturated[/u] [/i][size=3]and [/size][i][u]desaturated[/u] [/i][size=3]assets.[/size]

[size=3]This mod also has an option to use Legacy assets from [/size][url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/8980]Expansion Fish Redesign[/url] and acts as a config controller for it.
[size=2][i]Notes:
- If you choose legacy assets, there will not be a choice between saturated and desaturated assets. 
[/i][/size][i]- Make sure to disable all options from [color=#ffd966]Expansion Fish Redesign[/color] to avoid any conflict.
[/i]- There is also an optional file to use to overwrite the files from [i][color=#ffd966]Expansion Fish Redesign[/color] and remove any of the errors/warnings that might show in SMAPI[/i]

[b][color=#ffd966]Currently includes:[/color][/b]
[size=3]- Stardew Valley Expanded[/size]

[b][color=#ffd966]Future inclusions:[/color][/b]
[size=3]- More New Fish[/size][/center] [img]https://i.imgur.com/Uohxu8h.png[/img]﻿
[center][size=4][b][color=#ffd966]1.[/color] [/b]Download [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/1915]Content Patcher[/url] and [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/28284]CMCT[/url][color=#f4f4f4].[/color]﻿
[color=#ffd966]2.[/color][color=#f4f4f4][b] [/b]Download [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/8980]Expansion Fish Redesign[/url].
[/color][b][color=#ffd966]3.[/color][color=#e69138] [/color][/b]the original mod you intend to use.
[b][color=#ffd966]﻿4.[/color][/b] Drop it inside your Mods folder.
[b][color=#f6b26b]﻿[/color][color=#ffd966]5.[/color][/b] All done! Enjoy the mod ^^

[b][color=#ffd966]From here you can:[/color][/b][/size]
﻿- [size=3]Enable or disable any feature. For that, run SMAPI once to generate the config file of the mod and edit it manually or [/size][size=3]by using spacechase's [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/5098]Generic Mod Config Menu[/url]﻿.[/size][/center] 
[img]https://i.imgur.com/pOatute.png[/img]
[center]Many thanks to [url=https://next.nexusmods.com/profile/mrtaiyou]Taiyo[/url] for creating the amazing [color=#ffd966]Vanilla Tweaks[/color][b], [/b]and for permitting me to develop and release this mod.
Also, the [i][color=#b45f06]"Puppyfish"[/color][/i][color=#b45f06] [/color]asset is from Tai's original mod [color=#ffd966]Expansion Fish Redesign[/color], which was a huge inspiration for this mod.
This mod's photos are also inspired by Tai's original mod photos ^^

Huge thanks to [url=https://next.nexusmods.com/profile/Spiderbuttons]Spiderbuttons[/url]﻿ for creating [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/28284]CMCT[/url]﻿.

Thanks to ﻿[url=https://next.nexusmods.com/profile/FlashShifter]FlashShifter[/url] and the rest of the [color=#ffd966]SVE[/color][color=#e69138] [/color]team for the wonderful mod and for allowing retextures for their mod.

﻿Thanks to [url=https://next.nexusmods.com/profile/TrentXV]TrendXV[/url] and [url=https://next.nexusmods.com/profile/hisameartwork]Hisame[/url] for allowing me to retexture the fish from [color=#ffd966]MNF[/color][color=#e69138].[/color][/center][center][/center][center][color=#e69138][b]ConcernedApe [/b][/color]is awesome <3[/center][center]﻿[/center][img]https://i.imgur.com/4yhVVZd.png[/img]
